name: Raintech Gift Product for WooCommerce
author: raintech357

sections.description:
Raintech Gift Product for WooCommerce rewards your customers with a free gift once their cart reaches the amount you choose.

Features

  • Automatically adds a free gift when the cart subtotal reaches your minimum amount.
  • Automatically removes the gift if the subtotal drops below the minimum.
  • Gift is added at a price of 0, locked to quantity 1, and cannot be removed manually.
  • “Spend X more to get a free gift” progress notice on the cart and checkout pages.
  • Customizable progress message with {remaining}, {gift} and {min} placeholders.
  • Orders mark the gift line item with “Free Gift: Yes”.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Note: The gift product must be a simple, in-stock product.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the raintech-free-gift-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the zip via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Free Gift.
  4. Enable the feature, set the minimum cart subtotal, enter the gift product ID and save.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce 6.0 or newer must be installed and active.

Which products can be the gift?

Any simple, purchasable, in-stock product. Variable products are not supported as the gift.

Where do I find the gift product ID?

Go to Products in WordPress admin and hover over the product name. The ID is shown under the title.

Does the gift count towards the minimum amount?

No. Only regular cart items count towards the minimum subtotal.
